Greetings. 
This issue was actually addressed in the favorites refactor that came out with Avatar Dynamics at the end of last week. The screenshot you have there is clearly of the old dialog, from the old build, as the wording ("CHOOSE A PLAYLIST" is now "CHOOSE A LIST") and positioning of elements on the dialog has changed slightly since that update. I'm guessing you just waited a few days or more to make this Canny? Can you check your lists again and confirm whether or not you still have the problem as of the current build (1191)? I had a similarly affected account, and confirmed that my list as well as others I consulted with that were suffering from the same issue, were now functional again. Thanks.

details:
I've seen a couple other posts about this issue. One from 2019 and one from 2021. I'm making this post to let it be known this is still a problem, and I have a few more details.
This has been an unchanging issue for many months now. I cannot add anything to my first worlds playlist. When I go to favorite a world, it shows that list as being overly full (it is not) and my second list is 0/64 (in reality it is full). I try to add a world to the second playlist and it does not register.
I attempted to fix this once. Someone told to disable IPv6, so I did. Upon restarting my computer and turning the game on, the problem was fixed. However, the next time I got on, it was back to the usual.
I do not know what I might've done to cause this, as again, this started many months ago. I know I used to have the first playlist on private, and after making it public to friends and moving some things around, that is when the issue appeared.
title: Worlds Playlists Mixed Up - Unable to add to first playlist
